title: rosa pomifera subsp. gaudinii
intro: Rosa pomifera subsp. gaudinii, commonly known as Wild Apple Rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa pomifera plant, belonging to the Rosaceae family. The Wild Apple Rose is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating wounds, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
